plan.name: Trail 30 km, 1,000 m D+: 12-week plan
plan.description: A 12-week plan for a 30 km trail race with about 1,000 m of climbing, on 4 runs a week plus optional strength. Hill repeats, uphill tempo, power hiking with poles and downhill technique. The long run grows to 2h30 and 1,000 m D+, with a lighter week every 3–4 weeks and a 2-week taper.
plan.goal: Finish a 30 km trail race with 1,000 m D+

cycles.name: Base
cycles.description: Easy volume, short hill repeats and the first downhill drills. The long run grows by 10 to 15 minutes a week. Week 4 is lighter.

sessions.name: Hill repeats
sessions.description: 20 min easy to the bottom of an 8–12% climb, then 6 × 1'30 uphill at 88–93% of max heart rate, jogging or walking back down as recovery. 10 min cool-down. Heart rate lags on short efforts: aim for the top of the range by the end of each rep, and keep the last rep as good as the first.

sessions.name: Strength for trail (optional)
sessions.description: 30 min, at home, no equipment. 3 rounds of: 12 step-ups per leg onto a chair or a sturdy step, 10 split squats per leg, 15 slow calf raises on a step (3 seconds down), 30 s single-leg balance per leg with eyes closed, 30 s side plank per side. Quads take the hit on descents and ankles on rough ground: this is cheap insurance.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.description: 45 min easy on flat or rolling ground, 62–70% of VMA. You should be able to talk in full sentences.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.description: 40 min easy on flat or rolling ground, 62–70% of VMA. You should be able to talk in full sentences. Finish with 6 × 20" strides, walking back.

sessions.name: Long run with D+
sessions.description: 1h15 on trails with about 300 m D+, at 65–75% of max heart rate. Run the flats and gentle climbs, power-hike anything steeper than 15%, and practise eating every 30–40 minutes.

sessions.name: 30/30 on the flat
sessions.description: 20 min easy, then 2 × (8 × 30" fast / 30" jog), 3 min easy between sets, 10 min cool-down. Fast = 95–100% of VMA, jog = 60%. Flat ground or a track.
